name: Da Vinci
source:
"There we go! How's this? The energy charge percentage is..."

Based on Leonardo da Vinci.

EU's chief inventor and artist in one, she's in charge of their technical department. Da Vinci's a genius who invents things like air conditioning and robots, ignoring irrelevant things like the era she lives in. However, she has also created many failures, and her experiments eat through money like it were bread.

Da Vinci loves challenging herself to new things. She treasures her inventions as if they were her children.

[From [url=http://fruitbatfactory.com/eiyuusenki/char.html#char11d]English official site[/url]]
